name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) is the task's 'if you move the ball, you must also take the key' with no timing cue, so it stays even though the compiler marks it redundant. Existence(target_picked_up) is the commanded box pickup. Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) is the 'Then' order, and with the hard Existence it forces the key, so no separate Existence on the key is needed.

texts: If the ball is moved (blocker_moved), the agent must also take the key (has_door_key) at some point, before, with, or after the move.
The agent must pick up the target box in the other room, which is the final goal of the task.
The box pickup comes after the key is taken, since the task says 'Then pick up the box'.
